ashwin: Heads-up: catalpa11b (gptq-int4) canary started showing OOMs on mixed convo workloads after the new sparse-attn kernel landed. Error rate ~9% on canary pods for sessions with long history. Repro log below.

lucy: Is this after we flipped the allocator alignment change last week?

dan: Yep, the kernel patch changed workspace alignment + scratch allocation pattern for int4 kernels. That combined with aggressive prefetch seems to increase fragmentation.

ashwin: Repro snippet: 

```
# /var/log/inference/catalpa-canary.log
[2025-07-12T09:03:12Z] ERROR oom: gpu_alloc failed 52428800 bytes at gpu_pool.cc:88
[2025-07-12T09:03:12Z] INFO seq_len=1305 prefetch_slots=28 kv_cache=768MB post_frag=0.71
[2025-07-12T09:03:12Z] DEBUG serving-config: max_new_tokens=256 batch_size=8 prefetch=aggressive kernel=sparse-attn-v2
```

lucy: Quick local matrix I ran (50k requests with short+long mix):
- baseline (canary): OOM_rate 9.8% when seq>1100, p95 latency 480ms
- tweak A: max_new_tokens=96, batch_size=3, prefetch=conservative => OOM_rate 0.9%, p95 520ms
- tweak B: same as A + compactor.interval=90s + kv_trim_threshold=0.55 => OOM_rate 0.3%, p95 535ms
Tradeoff: latency up ~10% but much more stable.

dan: That matches theory: smaller batches & smaller max_new reduce peak working set; compactor+trim reduces live fragmentation. We should avoid global reverts. Model-level profile makes sense.

ashwin: Proposal for catalpa profile:
- model.profile.max_new_tokens = "96"
- model.profile.max_batch_size = "3"
- model.profile.prefetch = "conservative"
- runtime.kv_trim_threshold = "0.55"
- compactor.interval = "90s"
- fallback.variant = "catalpa11b-int8-std" when session_len > 750 or oom_rate > 2%
- runtime.soft_evict_free_mem = "900MB"  # evict oldest KV if free < threshold

lucy: Also add metric alerts: canary oom_rate > 3% for 5m => rollback; memfrag > 0.65 for 3m => pager.

ops-bot: @ashwin config-patch "catalpa11b: conserv-profile" applied to canary pool (12% traffic) by ops-bot at 1859997820 :wrench:

canary-bot: Canary update: catalpa11b profile v0.9-conservative (12% traffic) - monitoring window 20m.

ashwin: I'll queue a Redwood Optimize eval: convo-bench mix (60% short, 40% long), deterministic seeds, compare int4 new-profile vs int8 variant and fp16 baseline. Want OOM_rate, quality (ROUGE-L), and latency. Sam/ops can you add the eval to the perf dashboard?

dan: On it. Expect job ~1.5h. Will include per-segment memfrag traces.

lucy: Quick note: add a small kernel fallback: if sparse-attn-v2 kernel reports >5% alloc failures in last 10m, route to sparse-attn-v1 for that pod. Safer than rolling back the whole model.

ashwin: Good idea. I'll include kernel-fallback in the PR and short runbook steps.

lucy: (later) Eval results: int4 + conservative profile: OOM_rate 0.4% (down from 9.8%), ROUGE-L delta vs fp16 = -0.3%, avg latency +8%. int8 fallback: OOM_rate 0%, ROUGE-L delta vs fp16 = -1.0%, latency +4%. Recommendation: keep int4 with conservative profile + auto-fallback to int8 on session_len>750 or oom alert.

dan: Sounds reasonable. Add a canary monitor that tracks quality drift >1% ROUGE-L and blocks auto-promotion.

ashwin: PR: https://git.redwood/inference/infra/patches/2002 - contains model profile, kernel-fallback, compactor defaults, and runbook. Will merge on green. Tagging @lucy @dan for quick review.

ops-bot: Merge check: PR 2002 CI status: green.

canary-bot: Promotion plan: v0.9-conservative -> 25% after 30m stable -> 60% after 2h stable -> full. Auto-rollback if oom_rate > 2% or quality drift > 0.8% ROUGE-L.

lucy: Approved. Add a short how-to in the onboarding doc on interpreting memfrag graphs (showing pre/post compaction).

ashwin: Thanks all. Will follow up with the docs and patch release notes. :rocket:
